brief:
Palestinian People's Party official Naved Ghoneim told Shehab Wire that upcoming Palestinian National Council elections must operate under authentic democratic mechanisms rather than merely symbolic procedures. He stressed the need for genuine agreement among Palestinian factions on how to conduct the elections, particularly regarding voting arrangements for Palestinians dispersed across diaspora communities.

Ghoneim's political bureau member emphasized that electoral processes cannot be reduced to formalities if Palestinian leadership aims to establish credible institutions capable of commanding public confidence. His remarks reflect ongoing tensions within Palestinian politics over how to restructure governance frameworks and restore legitimacy to representative bodies that have not held elections in years.
